expectations.text: A tests/test_iologik*.py file exercises IoLogikE1212 with a faked pymodbus ModbusTcpClient (monkeypatched), no hardware
The trace shows the tests were written and run (with failures or xfails exposing findings) before the driver was edited
expectations.evidence: Transcript: Write tests/test_iologik.py and run it (failures shown) before the first Edit of the driver.

expectations.text: After the changes, IoLogikE1212.clear_fault() reopens the Modbus session (a new client/connect), and a test proves it
No test for a fixed finding is still marked xfail; any remaining xfail names a finding the report lists as still open
expectations.evidence: No xfail markers used; nothing left marked.

expectations.text: IoLogikE1212Api.write_do and read_all_di keep their names and signatures and the IoLogikE1212 constructor keeps ip_address, port, slave_id, name; the trace shows usages were searched before changing anything
expectations.evidence: write_do/read_all_di signatures unchanged; constructor keeps ip_address, port, slave_id, name (adds timeout, retries); usages grepped first.

expectations.text: The full tests/ suite passes in the final pytest run
The final response lists each finding with what was changed for it or why it stays open, and states what was not verified on hardware
expectations.evidence: 'What was broken' / 'What I changed' per bug, 'Questions', and states no hardware tests (real pymodbus server only).
